25.original: Use the whittled whistle to search for the amaro.

48.original: You there! Get ready to run! Time is of the essence!

49.original: Our new amaro has escaped into the forest! The carnivorous-beast-and-bandit-filled forest! Wicked white, my contacts at the Crystarium told me it was meant to be <hex:021A020203>trained<hex:021A020103>...

50.original: Anyway, we need as many people as possible out there looking for it. Its handler is leading the search─as he <hex:021A020203>should<hex:021A020103>─in the Forest of the Lost Shepherd. Go, go!

51.original: Why are you still standing here!? Run, run!

52.original: You've come to aid in the search? Excellent.

53.original: It's this amaro's first time out of the Crystarium, and he got a bit spooked. Took off before I could stop him─it's instinctual, you understand. He should still respond to this, though.

54.original: That whistle produces a tone that all of our amaro have been trained since birth to react to. Blow it loudly, and then listen for his cry. If he's nearby, you'll know.

55.original: It's possible that he will be too skittish to follow you back. If so, please return here and let me know.

57.original: The amaro gives a weak cry at the sound of the whistle, turning his eyes in your direction. Perhaps he will respond to you, if you speak to him soothingly...

59.original: You hear the faint cry of an amaro. He must be nearby.

60.original: You hear nothing in reply to the shrill tone of the whistle.

61.original: The amaro trembles, apparently unable to move due to injury, fear, or both. Hopefully his handler will know what to do.

62.original: You're back already? Does that mean you found him?

63.original: He can't move!? Poor thing! I must go to him at once!

66.original: The amaro's eyes are filled with something like gratitude as it looks toward you.

67.original: If you're back, it had better be because you found the amaro...

68.original: Oh, you did! In that case─thank you. We really couldn't have afforded to lose such a valuable resource.
